decisions.reason: The revised Flat Plan changes the issue structure reference but does not alter the polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The revised Flat Plan does not change the requirement to enhance image quality with AI when necessary.
The revised Flat Plan does not change the Civic Lantern website as the source of article content.
The revised Flat Plan does not remove or modify the requirement for each article to include the author's name and photo.
The revised Flat Plan does not change the required small circular presentation of author photos.
The revised Flat Plan may guide issue assembly but does not change the interactive digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
Providing a newer Flat Plan does not necessarily modify the independent obligation to create a magazine layout template.
The revised Flat Plan does not resume or otherwise change the deferred print-ready output requirement.
